palette.name: Navy
palette.usage: Use navy on light backgrounds or as a background colour to meet WCAG AAA accessibility standards.

palette.name: Sky
palette.usage: Secondary colourway background; wordmark colour on navy.

palette.name: White
palette.usage: Alternate colourway background; wordmark colour on navy.

techniques.name: Crop blooms inside frames
techniques.instruction: Scale them beyond the edge of the frame to create movement and energy. Layer them to introduce colour and depth.

techniques.name: Break the frame
techniques.instruction: Blooms can also break the frame, adding depth and a stronger sense of motion.

techniques.name: Pattern limits
techniques.instruction: Limit it to a maximum of three colours, and ensure the blooms work cohesively in both form and orientation.

techniques.name: Pattern intent
techniques.instruction: Patterns shouldn't be applied arbitrarily or purely for decoration. They should only be used with clear intent, where they add meaning, support the message, or enhance the overall composition.

techniques.name: Photography masking
techniques.instruction: In out-of-home, campaign, and top-of-funnel applications, crop photography into our blooms. Subjects can subtly break the mask to add depth.

techniques.name: Pill for busy backgrounds
techniques.instruction: When placing the Xero logo on busy backgrounds or over photography, use the pill. It makes the logo easy to spot and easy to read.

techniques.name: Social avatar centering
techniques.instruction: For social avatars, favicons and other small identifiers, centre the wordmark within a solid background. Be mindful that some platforms crop images into circles. Allow enough space to preserve legibility and visual balance.

techniques.name: Partner logo sizing
techniques.instruction: The partner logo should not exceed the visual size of the Xero wordmark. Where possible, align it to the same vertical height as the Xero wordmark.

techniques.name: Partner prominence
techniques.instruction: It's essential that third-party logos never appear visually larger than the Xero logo, ensuring our brand maintains appropriate prominence in all co-branded applications.

techniques.name: Patterning
techniques.instruction: In the right context, blooms can pattern and be used as a textural background element. Limit it to a maximum of three colours, and ensure the blooms work cohesively in both form and orientation.

techniques.name: Pill usage
techniques.instruction: When placing the Xero logo on busy backgrounds or over photography, use the pill. It makes the logo easy to spot and easy to read.

techniques.name: Partnership lockup
techniques.instruction: When representing partnerships with app partners or third-party providers, use a '+' symbol between the Xero logo and the partner logo. The partner logo should not exceed the visual size of the Xero wordmark. Where possible, align it to the same vertical height as the Xero wordmark.

techniques.name: Cropping inside frames
techniques.instruction: Scale them beyond the edge of the frame to create movement and energy. Layer them to introduce colour and depth.

techniques.name: Cropping that breaks the frame
techniques.instruction: Blooms can also break the frame, adding depth and a stronger sense of motion.

techniques.name: Blooms in photography
techniques.instruction: In out-of-home, campaign, and top-of-funnel applications, crop photography into our blooms. Subjects can subtly break the mask to add depth.

context_rules.name: Funnel simplicity
context_rules.when: Further down the funnel and in internal materials
context_rules.then: Keep things simpler with fewer colours and cleaner curves.
